games.name: PROJECT APEX
games.desc:
Participating in an experimental program that intends to push the boundaries of human capabilities through genetic manipulation and bioengineering, you and up to three other players will take on a mission-driven campaign that covers the history of the TITAN Corporation up until the global freeze, all experienced through the view of a helmet camera.

Weekends provide double income and XP.

Thumbnails made by Nik5715

⚠ WORK IN PROGRESS
This game is in demo. Tutorial, more missions, outbreak expansions, character model reworks, etc. will come in time. If you encounter any issues, please report them to us.

⦾ HARDWARE
Mid-ranged hardware is required to play this game at minimum performance. We try to balance our visual fidelity with high performance, however, there is a limit to our strategies.

games.name: Brainrot VS Mecha [Lv36 ~ Lv40]
games.desc:
Use various units from Multi-Universe to create your own unique epic battle. 

Update 36:
1. Three new equipment (Too weapon, One cloak)
2. New Event: Boss Event (Total 100 level)
3. Event interval reduced to about 3 minutes
4. Many bug fixes (such as FrigoCamelo cannot freeze enemy)

Update 35:
New mode: Event Mode

Instructions: 
1. Click on the unit icons to place units on the battlefield. 
2. Units placed on blue tiles represent the blue army, while units placed on red tiles represent the red army. 
3. Click on the play icon to start the battle between the red and blue armies.

Zombie Survival Garry's Mod is a game where a group of Survivors are present in an apocalyptic world with a threat of an incoming zombie horde hungry for their brains. Humans must prepare and work together and fight-off the zombies in order to prevail.

Work together with other survivors, create barricades using Carpenter's Hammer, cooperate, defeat Mini-Bosses, heal eachother using Medkits, and purchase arsenal of powerful weapons to gain an upperhand in-game.
